notes: SR115 Juttu Home (juttu.be). Checked main nav (top-level 'New collection' item plus per-department mega-menus), homepage teaser banners ('Nieuwe collectie dames'/'Nieuwe collectie heren'), and the full category sitemap for New Arrivals/Nieuw/Nieuwkomers/Nieuw binnen equivalents. The site uses 'New collection'/'Nieuwe collectie' as its own term for this concept (English label used directly in the Dutch UI). All candidates were opened and confirmed as real, filterable, paginated PLPs (not editorial/lookbook pages) via the embedded lister-component JSON (itemCount/totalPages fields), matching pattern used for the Bestsellers page. IMPORTANT FINDING - the site exposes TWO PARALLEL, DIFFERENTLY-SCOPED 'New Collection' taxonomies with different backend category ids and different item counts, not aliases of each other: (A) a top-level 'New Collection' node (nav item, category id 9826, parent=Home) that is CLOTHING-ONLY (facets confirm: Kleding types = Shirts & T-shirts/Truien/Broeken/Jassen etc, Merk = fashion brand list only, no home-deco items) with two real gender children (Dames id 11167, Heren id 11168); these two child URLs are reachable from the gender mega-menus but are NOT listed in the sitemap (only the parent is). (B) three separate DEPARTMENT-ROOTED 'New collection' nodes, each nested directly under its own department root and each in the sitemap: Dames (id 9814, parent Dames dept), Heren (id 9815, parent Heren dept), and Home & Deco (id 9816, parent Home & Deco dept) - confirmed via og:title 'Dames: new collection' / 'Heren: new collection' / 'Home & deco: new collection'. The Dames and Heren department-rooted counts (1123 and 481) are close to but NOT identical to structure (A)'s children (1025 and 471), so per the brief's rule against merging listings purely on similarity, all are kept as separate rows and the Dames/Heren department-rooted rows are flagged for manual review to resolve which taxonomy is authoritative. The Home & Deco department-rooted node (6 items, all 'Accessoires' type) has no analogous duplicate in structure (A) - home-deco is not represented in the top-level clothing-only New Collection at all - so it is recorded without a duplication flag; kept despite its small size per this project's established precedent of keeping genuine small/zero-count nav nodes rather than treating them as noise. Row 1's two children (1025+471=1496) sum to slightly more than the parent's own itemCount (1473), most likely due to unisex-tagged products counted in both gender sub-listings; noted as evidence, not altered. No department-level New Collection page exists for Cadeaus (gifts) in the sitemap - checked, absent.
